info.name: Swarna Bindu Gold Scheme REST API
info.description: A unified API collection for the Swarna Bindu Gold Scheme platform. Organized into separate "Client" and "Admin" flows for development convenience.

item.description: All user-facing mobile client endpoints under `/api/v1/...`. Separated for frontend developers integration.
